questions.question: Using detect_anomalies, how do the flagged anomalous time segments compare to the typical segments in the full silver Close time series?

answer.value: detect_anomalies(threshold=2) flags Close values farther than 2σ from the series mean (≈ 95 daily points in this dataset). Anomalies are time-clustered from about September 2025 through January 2026—matching a regime of elevated silver prices versus the long 2016–mid-2025 band. The non-anomalous majority tracks closer to the historical mean with smaller day-to-day deviations; the anomalous segment reads as a separate high-level plateau/spike rather than isolated one-off dots scattered uniformly across years.

key_insights: Anomaly points concentrate in a contiguous late-2025 window rather than being evenly scattered across the timeline.
Typical years sit near the global mean; flagged points mark a distinct high-price episode.

reasoning.reasoning: The tool automatically identifies outlier price movements that are not visually obvious in the full chart, uncovering structural anomalies in the silver price trend.
